name: Delegation (Power Apps)
short_description: Delegation in Power Apps canvas apps means a query is processed by the data source instead of the app; non-delegable queries only evaluate a limited number of records, which can silently return incomplete results on large SharePoint lists.

evidence.quote: Hoping delegation doesn't implode governance minimal.
delegation rules silently cap your queries
If a query can be delegated, the data source does the heavy lifting by filtering, sorting, and evaluating
lists scale exceptionally for thousands of items when queries are delegable and indexed
Then a column is renamed from status to state or a lookup becomes polymorphic. Delegation shifts.
That belief is why your apps stall at 2,000 records, choke on filters, and die behind a friendly blue delegation banner.
When Power Apps can't delegate a query, it pulls data to the client and evaluates locally.
Delegation fails, permissions tangle, performance collapses
Delegation means that the heavy lifting, the filtering, sorting, searching happens on the server close to the data.
those connectors obey delegation limits, the ceiling on how much data can be processed server side
The core culprit here is a polite little concept called delegation.
